description: Establish a green baseline before any changes. Install dependencies and run the project's existing typecheck, unit tests, and build so later features start from a known-passing state and regressions are attributable.
steps: cd /projects/sandbox/Easemyoffice. If node_modules is missing, run `bun install --frozen-lockfile`.

Run typecheck with the local binary: `./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit`. If it reports node not found, export PATH to the nvm node bin (see AGENT_CONTEXT.md §4: `export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/<ver>/bin:$PATH"`; check `ls /root/.nvm/versions/node` for the version) and retry.
Run the unit tests: `bun run test`. Note the baseline pass count (AGENT_CONTEXT.md records ~98 earlier; the repo has grown — just record the current numbers).
Run the build: `bun run build`. Confirm it completes and emits dist output.
Record the exact baseline numbers (tests passed/files, build success) in this feature's findings so later features can detect regressions. Do NOT modify any source in this feature.
acceptance_criteria: `bun run test` exits 0 with all test files passing; the baseline count is recorded in findings.
No source files were modified (git status clean apart from the .agents task dir).
verification: `bun run test` reports all files passing.
findings: Green baseline established on branch main (HEAD a02f2b7). No source files modified. Regression check for later features: expect tsc exit 0, 18 files / 261 tests passing, and a successful build.
